professionalSummary: Revenue Operations Analyst with experience maintaining CRM data quality, running weekly pipeline hygiene reports, building quarterly bookings forecast models with sales finance, administering territory and quota assignments, and documenting revenue operations processes.
experienceHighlights: Maintained CRM validation rules for opportunity stage, close date and amount, and ran weekly pipeline-hygiene reports for 40 account executives at Tallis Cloud (src_6150c7a3390d).
Built quarterly bookings forecast model in the planning tool with sales finance partner, combining weighted pipeline with run‑rate renewals (src_944f71b6d2a3).
Loaded territory and quota assignments into the CRM for fiscal‑year starts in February 2023 and February 2024, reconciling against the sales compensation plan (src_c5cd9f242e2e).
Prepared a deal‑slippage list each Friday for regional sales directors, flagging opportunities whose close date moved twice in the quarter (src_92eac18a7360).
Wrote 14 runbook pages covering lead routing, opportunity stage definitions and the quarter‑end close checklist (src_af97506cf071).
